Note: For this busy, urban commercial/residential area, the APTA guidelines for maximum levels of noise from ground-borne sources would be NC-30 to NC-35 (35 to 40 dBA). This criterion can be met using the standard resilient track fasteners with no special ties or floating slabs. For the short distance past the TV studio, however, NC-20 (25 dBA) is called for in the APTA guidelines. Floating slab construction is required at this location.
* 
Add 5 for approximate conversion to dBA. These noise levels are predicted based on an acoustical study of the site.
